summary: Linkage Global Inc, a Cayman-incorporated, Tokyo-based Nasdaq filer, disclosed a 6-K confirming it entered and consummated an Amendment and Exchange Agreement on October 14, 2026 with an institutional Holder. The Holder swapped its July 17, 2025 senior unsecured convertible note for a new senior unsecured convertible note with $1.7 million principal, maturing October 14, 2028, 10% interest (18% on default), initial $1.50 conversion price, $0.208 floor, 4.99% ownership blocker and 130% optional redemption. No new cash proceeds; Section 3(a)(9) exemption claimed. Watch dilution and floor-price resets.
